\begin{figure}[tbp]

  \caption{\textbf{Transfer to a held-out model family.} \textbf{A:} parameter recovery for the LBA, which was not among the training families, by the original CogFormer network without any LBA training (zero-shot, grey) and by the same network after fine-tuning on all four families (red), on the same 200 test datasets of the \emph{interaction} design: posterior means against ground truth with 90\% credible intervals, one $r$ per network. Columns are the parameters and rows the coefficients (intercept, slopes on $u_1$ and $u_2$, and on their product); N/A marks coefficients the design does not contain. \textbf{B:} change in each of the LBA's coefficients' NRMSE (top) and calibration error (bottom) with fine-tuning (fine-tuned minus zero-shot), cells laid out as in A. Negative values (blue) are improvements, positive values (red) deteriorations; each panel has its own colour scale. The LBA's largest change in magnitude is 0.621 in NRMSE and 0.483 in calibration error; for DDM, RDM and CDM (fine-tuned minus the original network, not shown) it is 0.004 and 0.039. \textbf{C:} posterior predictive RT quantiles for the empirical lexical-decision task after fine-tuning, grouped by speed/accuracy condition, word frequency and lexicality. Observed quantiles (squares, dashed) are compared with predictive medians (circles, solid) and central 95\% intervals (bands). The fit estimates both variability parameters. Details in Appendix~\ref{app:exp3-main-details}.}
